policy requires: authenticate the user identity

policy quote: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code.

We need to see if condition met: At the beginning of the conversation? The conversation started with user greeting, assistant responded, user gave name, etc. The assistant is still in process of authenticating. The policy says at the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.

Thus the assistant is performing authentication via name+zip. That's correct. The tool call is appropriate. No error.
